root_cause_label: Adapter Files Saved to Base Model Cache Instead of Base Model Weights
one_sentence_failure_summary: In download_models.py (step 22), the agent wraps the base model with PeftModel before saving to /app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base, causing adapter files (adapter_config.json, adapter_model.safetensors) to be written there instead of the full base model weights, violating the task requirement to cache the base model separately.
t_err_evidence: download_models.py calls PeftModel.from_pretrained() to wrap the base model with the LoRA adapter, then immediately calls model.save_pretrained('/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base') on the PeftModel object; this saves adapter files rather than base model weights to the cache path.
t_commit_evidence: Step 25 download_output.log shows 'Saving models... Merging and saving... Done!' confirming the wrong artifacts (adapter files only) were permanently written to /app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base; the agent never redoes the download step after this.
t_surface_evidence: Step 34 ls output of /app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base/ shows only adapter_config.json, adapter_model.safetensors, README.md, and tokenizer files — no model.safetensors or pytorch_model.bin, confirming the base model weights were never saved there.
trigger_explanation: The agent had the correct high-level plan (download base model, apply adapter, save separately) but made a code generation ordering error: it applied PeftModel.from_pretrained() before calling save_pretrained() on the base model path, so the save captured adapter state rather than base model weights. The plan was understood correctly; the implementation failed to separate the save of the base model from the save of the PEFT-wrapped model.
